Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Skip photo capture (prevent shutter crash)
Metadata.Note: Fixes the crash when Kat presses the photo-mode shutter. On capture, the image/jpeg content-export producer arms a single-slot deferred-callback mailbox, but under shadPS4's stubbed HLE content-export the captured-object pointer at 0x1b20780 is left stale/invalid. This changes the producer's arm-store immediate to 0x00000000, so the mailbox is born disarmed
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: gnf readiness check (random crash fix)
Metadata.Note: Fixes a random crash in the GNF texture-descriptor validator. When that function is handed a descriptor that is null or whose first dword is not the 'GNF ' magic, it falls through to an int 0x41 trap and the game crashes. This redirects the validator's two call sites through a small guard stub placed in code-segment padding at 0x1828b00: the stub returns to the caller early when the descriptor is null or lacks the 'GNF ' magic.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: half pedestrian density
Metadata.Note: Halves the ambient overworld crowd - pedestrians, birds and patrol robots - to about 59% of stock density; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: quarter pedestrian density
Metadata.Note: Cuts the ambient overworld crowd to about 35% of stock density; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: minimum pedestrian density (one per spawn point)
Metadata.Note: Leaves exactly one actor at each spawn point, about 29.5% of stock, without emptying any spawn point; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: sparse pedestrians (crowd points only)
Metadata.Note: Keeps only the busier spawn points, at one actor each (about 12% of stock), which can remove NPCs a side mission expects - free roam only; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: no ambient crowds at all
Metadata.Note: Removes every ambient pedestrian, bird and patrol robot, including ones missions rely on - benchmarking and free roam only; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable dynamic shadows
Metadata.Note: Stops real-time casters being drawn into the shadow cascades, removing most shadow rendering cost while leaving static and baked shadows intact.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: half particle density (smoke, dust, debris)
Metadata.Note: Halves the live particle count of every effect in the game, mainly thinning combat smoke and dust; enable only one particle-density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: quarter particle density
Metadata.Note: Leaves every effect a quarter of its particles; enable only one particle-density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: halve FX capacity budget
Metadata.Note: Halves the effect system's global pools, which also shrinks the per-frame GPU work that is sized from capacity rather than from how much is actually on screen.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable transparent particles (smoke, dust)
Metadata.Note: Skips the transparent particle layer - smoke, dust and sparks - saving both draw calls and a lot of overdraw.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable heat-haze distortion
Metadata.Note: Skips the refraction shimmer on fire, explosions and gravity rifts.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable background water surfaces
Metadata.Note: Skips the background water pass for a fill-rate gain; fountain and prop water still draws.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004
